assets.name: app-icon
assets.prompt: Use case: logo-brand asset extraction/edit. Edit the supplied selected Laut logo proposal into ONE production macOS app icon. Preserve the EXACT identity and geometry of the SMALL APP ICON at the lower right of the reference: deep petrol/teal rounded square containing the white softly rounded speech bubble with its little lower-left tail and exactly two horizontal teal transcript-line openings, upper line longer than lower. Square canvas, icon tile occupies about 82% of canvas width and height, centered, clear fully transparent margin on all sides, no shadow outside the tile. Bubble correctly centered optically in tile. Crisp truly flat solid colors, remove mottled paper texture, no gradient, no dimensional lighting. Only ONE app icon at high resolution. Remove all wordmarks, all other sample logos, and the off-white presentation-board background. No text. Preserve chosen design rather than inventing another speech bubble. Real alpha transparency outside rounded tile.

This is the selected design being prepared as a GitHub README logo, not a new design exploration.
